briefing.title: Assault on the Line
lines: Company commander, listen up. Enemy assault expected on our sector within minutes.
Armour leads, then transports with mechanised infantry. Expect drones and artillery first.
Your orders: Forward, Hold, Back, Retreat. Use drones on armour, rifles on infantry.
Stay in cover and stay concealed. Do not let one enemy unit into the deployment zone.

Intel: HQ to all units: enemy column massing beyond the ridge. Assault is coming.
Recon counts armour and transports in the column. Infantry rides behind the tanks.
Expect the main axis along the road toward our centre.
Scouting: Enemy scout drones over the line. Keep your heads down.
Revealed units are being tracked. Hold or fall back.
Scout drones reveal at 150 metres. Do not move in the open.
Bombardment: Artillery on revealed positions. Stay in cover and ride it out.
Concealed squads are not on their target list. Revealed ones are.
Recon reports guns are firing from beyond our range.
Shelling will lift as the armour closes. Expect engines next.
VehicleAdvance: Armour on the road, closing fast. Save drones and anti-tank for the vehicles.
Rifles will not stop armour. Use anti-tank teams and drones.
Light armour is exposed to heavy machine guns. Hold the line.
Anti-tank teams hold fire until vehicles are in range.
MechanizedInfantry: Transports behind the armour. They will stop and unload 300 to 600 metres out.
Drones can still reach them before they dismount. Strike the transports.
Infantry dismounting, coming on foot. Hold the line with rifles.
Enemy infantry now inside rifle range of the forward squads.

squad_lost: {squad} is down. No contact on the net.
artillery_incoming: Impact in seconds at {zone}. Heads down.
transport_unloading: Transport stopped at {distance} m. Infantry unloading.
Troops on foot at {distance} m. Prepare to receive.

routing_message: The enemy is routing — victory is near.
